title: automation compliance controls and policies
description: Formal JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) for docs/compliance-controls.yml — the internal control catalog (CTL) and ISMS policy set (POL). Mirrors the structural rules enforced by scripts/validate-compliance-controls.py (LIMITATIONS.md L6). The script additionally enforces runtime rules a schema cannot express: (a) at least one of controls/policies is non-empty, (b) every referenced role directory exists under roles/, and (c) bidirectional role<->id cross-references with each role's defaults/main.yml header. Validation against this schema is performed by the script when the optional `jsonschema` package is installed; otherwise the structural check runs and this file stands as the published contract.

controls.description: Control catalog. Keys are CTL-NNN identifiers.

policies.description: ISMS policy set. Keys are POL-NNN identifiers.

regulatoryMapping.description: Non-empty list of 'Framework Article — description' strings (hyphen or em dash separator).

roles.description: Roles that implement this control/policy. Each must exist as a directory under roles/ (enforced by the validator script). Required on controls; optional on policies.

retention_tiers.description: Optional retention-tier map (days as integer or string), e.g. for CTL-002 evidence retention.
